description: Web app: Browse section on Home page with Genre/Country tabs, language dropdown in header with 7 languages, full i18n integration, and TMDB language-aware API calls.
steps: Step 1: Create the BrowseSection component at apps/web/src/components/BrowseSection.jsx. Netflix pill/segment control tab switcher with 'Genre' and 'Country' tabs. Use the existing TabNavigation component pattern but style as pill/segment (rounded bg, active pill highlighted). Genre tab: responsive grid (grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 xl:grid-cols-6) of genre cards with localized names. Each card: dark bg (#1a1a1a), rounded-lg, hover effect, cursor-pointer. Country tab: same responsive grid with flag emoji + localized country name for all 14 countries. Click navigates to /genre/:id or /country/:code route.
Step 2: Add BrowseSection to the Home page (apps/web/src/app/Home.jsx). Place it after the hero banner and before or between content rails. Add section title 'Browse' (localized) above the tabs.

Step 3: Create genre detail page at apps/web/src/app/GenreDetail.jsx. Route: /genre/:id. Shows ContentGrid of content filtered by genre using the new API getGenres and discover endpoints. Uses useInfiniteQuery pattern. Header shows localized genre name.

Step 4: Create country detail page at apps/web/src/app/CountryDetail.jsx. Route: /country/:code. Shows ContentGrid of content filtered by origin country using getDiscoverByCountry. Header shows flag + localized country name.
Step 5: Add routes for /genre/:id and /country/:code in apps/web/src/App.jsx. Lazy-load GenreDetail and CountryDetail components.

Step 6: Replace the existing EN/ID language toggle in apps/web/src/components/Layout.jsx with a proper language dropdown. Dropdown button shows current language code or flag. On click, reveals a dropdown menu with all 7 languages (native names + flag emoji). Styled with Netflix dark theme (bg-[#1a1a1a], rounded, shadow). Clicking a language calls setLocale, updates state, closes dropdown. Dropdown closes on outside click.
Step 7: Integrate useTranslation() throughout the web app. Update Layout.jsx nav links to use t() for labels. Update Home.jsx section titles. Update Search.jsx placeholder text.

Step 8: Make TMDB API calls language-aware. In apps/web/src/utils/api.js, update fetchWithCache and all API methods to accept/forward the current language. The language should come from the i18n context or be passed as a parameter. Update react-query keys to include language so data refetches on language change.

Step 9: Ensure language change triggers TMDB content refetch. In the LanguageProvider or Layout, when language changes invalidate react-query cache or include language in query keys so content updates automatically.
acceptance_criteria: Web home page has Browse Grid section with Genre and Country tabs
Genre tab shows responsive grid of genre cards with localized names
Country tab shows responsive grid with flag + localized country name for 14 countries
Clicking genre/country card navigates to detail page with filtered content
Language dropdown in web header shows 7 languages with native names
Selecting language updates all UI text immediately
TMDB content displays in selected language
Language persists in localStorage, defaults to id-ID on first visit
Web build passes with zero errors
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/HIJISTREAM/apps/web && bun install && bun run build
